children: Graphene & Solar Technologies announced approval to trade on the OTCQB Venture Market and a private offering of up to $40 million in convertible notes.
Common stock began trading on the OTCQB Venture Market on Sept. 15, 2026, under ticker GSTX—aims to boost visibility and liquidity.
OTCQB approval required meeting higher financial, reporting, verification and market-eligibility standards than OTCID Basic.
GSTX is conducting a private offering of up to $40 million of convertible notes to support U.S. silicon wafer manufacturing development.
Through U.S. subsidiary QSM USA, planned San Diego facility is expected to provide up to 10 GW of wafer capacity when fully operational.
QSM USA has a long-term offtake agreement for 30% of planned output and GSTX was awarded a $45 million California Competes Tax Credit subject to milestones.
